Arcilia, officially the Third Republic of Arcilia is an unrecognised micronation in Asia that claims de facto sovereignty over 0.0001 km²(0.00003861 sq mi) of land enclaved by Azerbaijan.

History
Arcilia was established in 2024 as a dependent territory of another micronation, Soyusfen and New Solgiyar (Vespia) due to separatist movements. It declared full independence in the summer of 2025, establishing the First Republic of Arcilia. But this was short-lived, as the vespian-backed PMD (Polynesian Melod Dine) successfully overthrew the government, establishing the de facto Anarchy of Arcilia under the de facto rule of the PMD. "The darker times" ended after 2 months, when the government was overthrown again, this time by republicans. The Second Republic of Arcilia was formed and later vassalized by Azerbaijan a week later. Arcilia gained de facto independence on 28th of December 2025 with the Declaration of Independence, forming the de facto independent Third Republic of Arcilia. The Constitution of Arcilia, consisting of just 543 words was adopted on 25th of February 2026.
National symbols
According to the Constitution of Arcilia, there are three national symbols: The Republican Flag of Arcilia, the seal and anthem. Though the latter one doesn't exist.
The Republican Flag of Arcilia is in a 23:31 aspect ratio with 4 colours. Green represents the flora, the blue represents the always blue sky and Turkic heritage while the white represents peace. The orange symbol on the flag is the centerpiece, representing courage and resilience of the Arcilian people.
Culture
System of length measurement
Arcilia uses both metric and tantic (only recognised in Arcilia) systems. A single tant is equal to 29 centimeters and is separated into 10 segments (each 2.9 cm), named a millitant.
Music
Music is widespread in Arcilia, with one harmonica, one violin and a piano located in the micronation. Tough radio and TV are the main source of music.
Demographics
Population
According to the 2025 census and estimates, the population of Arcilia is 1. A 0% increase from the 2024 census.

Diversity
There is practically no ethnical diversity in Arcilia, 100% of the population being native(Turkic-derived). The only citizen of the country is technically an Azerbaijani immigrant, despite identifying as "Arcilian". The lack of multiculturalism didn't stop the micronation from being secular though.
Religion
The only resident of the micronation is a Sunni Muslim and there are reportedly three Quran's in the micronation.
Languages
There are two official and recognised languages in Arcilia: Azerbaijani and English. Azerbaijani has higher status, being the first language of the single citizen, and predominantly used in documents. Other spoken languages are Russian, Turkish and Ukrainian.
Health
Healthcare is completely absent in the micronation, despite being free by law. 0% of the population is obese or overweight. But 100% of the population has an eye defect.
Education
There is no universal education in Arcilia, but homeschooling is possible. Education outside of the micronation is recommended as education is required till 11th grade. There is a single library in North Bedroom, which is a book nook.
Geography
Arcilia is fully located in Asia, just north of the Middle East. It is completely surrounded by Azerbaijan and North Balcony is a detached exclave also inside Azerbaijan. All the 100 m² land of the country is completely indoors, providing a fully flat terrain.
Climate
As the country is indoors, it has little exposure to the climate. The two balconies and a few windows provide most of the air supply. It is hotter towards the south, and a lot windier and colder towards the north.
Fauna
The country has no wildlife, and only one mammal lives here, which is also the national animal: the domestic bicolour shorthair cat
(Felus catus)
Flora
Most of the limited number of plants in the country which are potted, are located in the governatory of South Balcony.
Politics
Constitution
The country has a constitution consisting of just 543 words, forming the backbone of every other law in the micronation. It possesses 7 chapters, 24 articles and 53 clauses.
Elections
The president of Arcilia and the members of the Parliament of Arcilia are both elected 1-year terms. Everyone can vote and be elected regardless of gender and even age.
Legislature
The Parliament of Arcilia is a unicameral parliament with 1 speaker and 6 representatives (one representative per each governatory).
Judiciary
There are two types of courts in Arcilia: The High Court and The Governatorial Court. There are 6 Governatorial Courts and one High Court. The death penalty is still legal in Arcilia.
Subdivisions
The country is divided into 6 governatories. These are North Bedroom, South Bedroom (public and presidential capital), Hall (executive, legislative and judiciary capital), South Balcony, North Balcony, Corridor. The smallest governatory is the North Balcony, while the biggest one is the Hall.
Military
Arcilia possesses a tiny army because of its population, called the Arcilian Free Armed Forces (AFAF). Armed with a 1973 Bajkal shotgun and a metal fighting pole. The two branches of the military are National Republican Guard(presidential guard) and the Land Forces.
Military service isn't mandatory.
